technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early stochrsi reversal signal, but severe downtrend structure with price below all major moving averages, negative momentum, and no bullish confirmation—high risk of continued decline despite oversold bounce potential.

fundamental.summary: EPAM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk with 22 days to announcement.

sentiment.summary: Broad market fear (VIX-like conditions) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but senior congressional selling (McCaul, $115k-$150k total Sep-Oct) and lack of recent news data create mixed signals with slight bearish lean.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (389.12) with FOMC event today creates severe macro headwinds; earnings in 22 days adds moderate binary risk to IT sector exposure.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9 & 14) with StochRSI upward cross in fear-zone environment offers contrarian bounce potential with support at 435.90 nearby.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, deeply negative MACD, no bullish momentum confirmation, FOMC event today, earnings binary risk in 22 days, and VIX crisis (389.12) create severe structural headwinds that overshadow oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9 & 14) with StochRSI upward cross offers contrarian bounce potential in fear-zone environment. However, severe structural bearishness—price below all major moving averages, deeply negative MACD, no bullish confirmation, and VIX crisis (389.12) with FOMC event today—creates unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event today combined with VIX crisis (389.12) and earnings binary risk in 22 days creates macro headwinds that could trigger further downside despite oversold technicals; price structure remains deeply bearish with no momentum confirmation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear dominance; technical, fundamental, sentiment, and risk all point to unfavourable conditions despite isolated oversold signal
decision.portfolio_note: Already 16 positions in Information Technology sector; adding EPAM increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro crisis without conviction support.
